name: com.apiumhub.vyou_core.login.vyou_auth.AuthWebviewActivity
description: VYou (Apiumhub) opens this screen when the app starts a VYou sign-in flow. It displays VYou's authorization page and returns the sign-in result to the app.
disableEffect: VYou sign-in cannot finish, so features that require a VYou account may not work.
